content.body: NWCORNERWARN = This is an edge corner of the battlezone, the enemy is behind you! churchentry = The church steeple makes a good lookout point! toalliedspawn = The enemy is north east of you across town! toaxisspawn = The enemy is south west of you across town! playarea = You cannot leave the battlezone except by dying! victory1 = Allies victorious! victory2 = Axis victorious! roundstop = This round is over!
content.brief:
The Allied troops have reached the town of Spa and are infiltrating from the woods outside of town. The German defenders must stop them!
Kill as many enemy infantry as possible in 15 minutes
The first team to reach 50 kills wins.
content.title: Infantry death match in Spa WIP
